_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score 29 sits in Panic and the base rate shows 97% of 12h windows are sub-2pt moves—a coil where HOLD is the statistically honest default until ETF flows or a VIX spike breaks the range.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing a compressed coil; narrative implies an imminent UP reversal via a violent snap-back, creating a directional split
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks $67k on volume with ETF flows >40 and stablecoin growth >55, shifting phase to Denial (32-38)
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX >25 with BTC momentum dropping below 45 and funding flipping negative, deepening the Panic leg toward Capitulation
